tag.name: GA4 - contact_whatsapp
tag.notes: WhatsApp is how most customers reach us. Without this the main conversion is invisible.

tag.name: GA4 - payment_initiated
tag.notes: The step between begin_checkout and purchase. Without it you cannot see where checkout leaks.

tag.name: GA4 - payment_failed
tag.notes: A customer tried to pay and could not. The single most actionable failure on the site.

tag.name: GA4 - payment_dismissed
tag.notes: Customer closed the payment overlay — hesitation, not an error.

tag.name: GA4 - payment_start_failed
tag.notes: Checkout could not even be started; `reason` carries the message.

tag.name: GA4 - payment_unconfirmed
tag.notes: Paid but we never confirmed — the case where a customer is charged and left unsure.

tag.name: GA4 - pay_link_opened
tag.notes: A pay link you sent was opened. The only measure of that channel working.

tag.name: GA4 - pay_form_invalid
tag.notes: The pay page rejected the form before PayHere saw it.

tag.name: GA4 - quote_link_opened
tag.notes: A customer opened a quote you sent on WhatsApp.

tag.name: GA4 - quote_lapsed_shown
tag.notes: They opened it after it expired — you are losing sales to the 7-day window.

tag.name: GA4 - manage_opened
tag.notes: Customer opened their booking. `has_balance` flags who still owes money.

tag.name: GA4 - manage_link_invalid
tag.notes: A manage link failed to open — a broken link in a real confirmation email.

tag.name: GA4 - login
tag.notes: Google sign-in on the ride board; the gate every join must pass.

tag.name: GA4 - scratch_ride
tag.notes: A traveller withdrew from a list — the board's churn signal.

tag.name: GA4 - ride_board_refused
tag.notes: The board turned a traveller away (list closed, van full, date too soon). `reason` is the API error code.

tag.name: GA4 - ride_board_payment_failed
tag.notes: A card approval for a board seat did not complete — cancelled, expired, or still pending.

tag.name: GA4 - reprice_shown
tag.notes: We told the customer the price moved. Pair with reprice_accepted for the accept rate.

tag.name: GA4 - reprice_accepted
tag.notes: They accepted the new price. The other half of the reprice rate.

tag.name: GA4 - route_estimate_update
tag.notes: A live estimate replaced a catalogue one. Tells you if the engine is answering in time.

tag.name: GA4 - route_estimate_unavailable
tag.notes: The engine did not answer and the customer saw a fallback price.

tag.name: GA4 - exact_location_deferred
tag.notes: Customer skipped giving an exact pickup/drop — a driver-side problem later.

tag.name: GA4 - exact_location_out_of_range
tag.notes: The pin was outside the serviceable radius; `km` sizes the demand you are refusing.
